items.title: Progress Rail and Wabtec Reach a Settlement in Antitrust Case
items.summary: ALBERTVILLE, AL and PITTSBURGH, Feb. 26, 2026 – Progress Rail, a Caterpillar company, and Wabtec Corporation (NYSE: WAB) announced today that the two parties have reached a settlement in Progress Rail v. Wabtec. The parties agree that this settlement is best for both companies, customers, and consumers, and the prospect of additional litigation is not in anyone’s interest. There is no admission of liability. The two companies acknowledge that they have been and remain suppliers of long-haul freight locomotives and cab components, including Tier IV long-haul locomotives, to Class I Railroads and other customers.

items.title: How Animals Impact Our Electrical Infrastructure
items.summary: Wildlife and electrical infrastructure share the same space, and that relationship has an impact on electric reliability. Animals can cause outages by chewing on lines, building nests on equipment, or creating unintended electrical paths. At Unitil, wildlife is responsible for roughly 13%* of power outages across our service territory, making it a common cause of service interruptions. Most animal-related outages occur in the spring and the fall when animals are most active.
